correctness.rationale: Use equivariant quotient of oriented r-simplex chains by boundaries of (r+1)-simplices and pure-part r-chains to present H_{r-1}. Each simplex orbit has an orientation-reversing stabilizer transposition, so its integral coinvariants are exactly Z/2. All remaining relations are (a mod 2)e_{a-1}+(b mod 2)e_a for feasible color counts. Odd/even parity cases yield the stated d formula including m+n=r+1 and boundary corrections. Independent parity-orbit rank reconstruction matched 392 parameter triples. The quotient is explicitly homology coinvariants, never geometric quotient homology.
